access_links.label: Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal dataset page

description: Routes nommées is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement de Corse. Portion de voie de communication destinée aux automobiles, aux piétons, aux cycles ou aux animaux, homogène pour l'ensemble des attributs et des relations qui la concerne, et qui possèdent réellement un nom de rue droit ou un nom de rue gauche (d'où le nom de la classe routenommée). Coverage: Corsica. Its keywords are escalier, sentier, chaussée, route, données ouvertes, chemin. The portal shows 33,434 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-oddc-datacorsica-portal.
